user.title: Connect iCloud Contacts
user.description: Use an app-specific password from account.apple.com (Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords), not your Apple ID password. It only reaches iCloud services like Contacts and can be revoked at any time.

card.title: Choose your contact card
card.description: Pick the card whose Home address should follow your location. Usually your own (the "My Card" in Contacts).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate iCloud
reauth_confirm.description: iCloud rejected the app-specific password for {apple_id}. Create a new one and enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: iCloud rejected the Apple ID or app-specific password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not list iCloud contacts ({error}). Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.no_contacts: No contacts were found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Apple ID is already set up.

set_home_address.name: Set home address
set_home_address.description: Writes the Home address on the chosen iCloud contact. The address comes from explicit fields, an entity's address attributes (such as a Companion app geocoded location sensor), or coordinates reverse-geocoded with OpenStreetMap.

config_entry_id.name: iCloud account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to update. Only needed if more than one is set up.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: A geocoded location sensor (address used directly) or a device tracker or person (coordinates reverse-geocoded).

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Reverse-geocode these coordinates instead of an entity.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Reverse-geocode these coordinates instead of an entity.

state.name: State
state.description: Overrides the resolved state or region.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Resolve and return the address without writing it to iCloud.
